name: ffmpeg
why: Builds the learning videos and cleans up audio.

win32.check: if (-not (Get-Command ffmpeg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -or -not (Get-Command ffprobe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { exit 1 }; ffmpeg -version; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; ffprobe -version; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }
